name: CorrectCommunicationLink
transaction_boundary: one LLD-01 UnitOfWork; current target/new target owner validation plus old-link close/new-link create/retention reevaluation are atomic
guards: RETARGET requires complete valid new target fields and owner validation VALID
correction never rewrites canonical message identity/content
receipt_order: replay -> revalidate -> insert command_receipt -> close old link -> optional create new link -> retention/events -> audit/results -> commit
revision_effects: old link closes with revision increment; replacement gets new immutable link id revision=1; if no dependencies remain orphan grace starts
